data.title: Codec immutable-release recovery
data.description: Review the burned 1.1.1 disclosure, 1.1.2 version bump, and fail-closed organization-enforced immutable-release preflights.

data.body: BLOCKER: This preflight cannot succeed with github.token. GitHub documents GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/immutable-releases as requiring repository Administration (read), but Administration is not an available GITHUB_TOKEN workflow permission; this job supplies no GitHub App or PAT token. The endpoint is also not anonymously readable (live request returns 401). Therefore both prepare-release and publish-release deterministically stop here even when enabled=true and enforced_by_owner=true. Rework the proof to use an actually authorized, least-privilege credential or move org-policy verification to an acceptance/protected-environment gate that the workflow can consume without weakening the no-secret policy. Keep the existing post-publication immutable=true readback.

data.reason: The new immutable-release preflight uses github.token for an endpoint requiring repository Administration (read), a permission GITHUB_TOKEN cannot receive. Both prepare and publish are therefore dead-gated; rework the proof credential or acceptance-gate design before merge.
